description: Fetch a public web page and return its main content as clean Markdown (readability extraction): title, url, final_url, markdown, word_count. HTML, plain text, Markdown, JSON and XML. Static fetch only (no JavaScript rendering). Respects robots.txt, blocks private/loopback/metadata hosts, max 3 MB / 15 s, no logins or paywall bypass. For PDFs use read_pdf. Failed reads are not charged. Costs $0.002 USDC per call via x402.
